scope: Source-preserving minimal Hydra composition of tokenizer-specific defaults chain; not full upstream runtime config instantiation

reproduction_yaml.stage3.yaml:
defaults:
  - tokenizer: wan
  - _self_
model:
  config:
    sigma_data: 1.0
    scaling: rectified_flow
reproduction_yaml.stage102.yaml:
defaults:
  - stage3
  - _self_
model:
  config:
    tokenizer:
      temporal_window: 16
reproduction_yaml.libero.yaml:
defaults:
  - stage102
  - override tokenizer: policy_wan
  - _self_
model:
  config:
    tokenizer:
      chunk_duration: 33
reproduction_yaml.inference.yaml:
defaults:
  - libero
  - _self_
model:
  config:
    sde:
      sigma_max: 80
      sigma_min: 4
